rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a given name, especially when contrasted with a surname.

example.english: In your full name, which part is your first name and which part is your surname?
example.traditional: 喺你個全名入面，邊個係名，邊個係姓呀？
example.jyutping: hai2 nei5 go3 cyun4 meng2 jap6 min6 bin1 go3 hai6 meng2 bin1 go3 hai6 sing3 aa3
